title: The Owner reads the Flows page as a daily growth view: one controls table, Paid ads as its own chapter, admin on its own page
description: The Flows page asks one question twice and mixes the daily view with admin. Flow controls and the Supervisor table both list every flow with whether it runs and why; Paid ads, its own flow, sits inside the activation flow's Reach chapter; and CSV uploads, opening a region, activation targets, raw JSON config and the admin log sit at the bottom of the page the Owner reads every morning. Merge the Supervisor table into FlowControls: one row per flow, a group named after the flow, holding its on/off button, Run now, the dial and the one gate word that says why it is or is not running, and delete SupervisorPanel. Move FlowAdmin off the Flows page into a new AdminPage exported from packages/web/src/flows, reached by a link to /growth/admin. Give Paid ads its own chapter. Delete the unrouted FlowPage. Nothing here changes what fwd does.
acceptance: SupervisorPanel is gone and the Flows page does not render it

Each flow's row in FlowControls is a group named after the flow with its gate word, on/off, Run now and dial; the kill switch shows in the row as its gate word; an unknown spend reads Unknown, never zero

The Flows page does not render FlowAdmin and links to /growth/admin; packages/web/src/flows exports AdminPage, which shows the uploads, Open the next region, Activation targets, Edit raw config and Admin log panels
Paid ads is its own chapter on the Flows page, not inside Reach
